name: Pumped hydro storage
principle: Water is pumped to an upper reservoir when power is cheap and released through turbines when needed. NREL's 2024 baseline uses 80% round-trip efficiency (literature range 70 to 87%) and 8, 10 or 12 hour durations; US capacity was about 23 GW in 2021.
